title: Electricity: Refund Granted, Rate Increase Blocked
summary:
*   Approved an electric rate refund for customers as requested by the Lower Colorado River Authority (LCRA).
*   Rejected Texas Utilities Electric Company's (TU Electric) proposal to increase electricity rates within city limits.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For SPECIAL CALLED MEET-ING - February 13, 1990 - 3:00 P.M.
Council Chambers. 30? Wtsl Second Street, Austin. Texas Mayor Pro Tern Shipman called to
order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the absence of Mayor Cooke and
Councilmember Urdy. The time was 4:24 P.M.
The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember Nofziger's second,
waived the requirement for three readings and finally passed the following ordinances all
in one consent motion: (5-0 Vote, Mayor Cooke and Councilmember Urdy absent) Approved an
ordinance regarding the Lower Colorado River Authority's request to make an electric rate
refund.
Approved an ordinance denying Texas Utilities Electric Company's request for authority to
change its rates within the City's corporate boundaries.
ADJOURNMENT
The meeting was adjourned at 4:25 P.M.
